cases.name: Joyce Lynn Yost
cases.narrative: He saw Joyce leaving a supper club and followed her home, ambushed her in the parking lot of her apartment and sexually assaulted her there and took her to his home where he sexually assaulted her again. Ten days before his trial, he broke into her home, stabbed her to death and her body has never been found.

cases.name: Shiela Jean Dunn

She was stabbed in the back, front torso and neck multiple times.
